content.value: Python supports for loops for iterating over sequences and while loops for running code while a condition remains true.

concepts.name: for loop
concepts.description: A loop that repeats once for each item in a sequence or iterable.

concepts.name: while loop
concepts.description: A loop that repeats as long as its condition remains true.

concepts.name: Iteration
concepts.description: One repetition of a loop or the process of stepping through items one at a time.

concepts.name: Sequence traversal
concepts.description: Visiting each item in an ordered collection such as a string, list, or range.

concepts.name: Loop condition
concepts.description: The expression that controls whether a loop continues running.

concepts.name: Infinite loop
concepts.description: A loop that never reaches a stopping condition and continues indefinitely.
